attribution.title: Ruiterstandbeeld Wilhelmina - reconstruction from photographs
attribution.author: Map Recall; sculpture by Theresia van der Pant (1972); figure reconstructed from photographs by Stephencdickson, Gouwenaar, Pēteris
attribution.modifications: Figure reconstructed (TRELLIS.2 multi-view) from Wikimedia Commons photographs: "Statue of Queen Wilhelmina of the Netherlands, Amsterdam.jpg" by Stephencdickson (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Statue_of_Queen_Wilhelmina_of_the_Netherlands,_Amsterdam.jpg); "Wilhelmina Rokin door Theresia van der Pant.jpg" by Gouwenaar (CC0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Wilhelmina_Rokin_door_Theresia_van_der_Pant.jpg); "File by Peteris P1170742 (3666927469).jpg" by Pēteris (CC BY 2.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:File_by_Peteris_P1170742_(3666927469).jpg); "Wilhelmina2 Rokin door Theresia van der Pant.jpg" by Gouwenaar (CC0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Wilhelmina2_Rokin_door_Theresia_van_der_Pant.jpg). Decimated to about 6,000 triangles per figure in the kit's material, no photo colour; plinth, pier and setting are the original low-poly kit model. Provenance: scripts/sculptures/rebuild-sources/wilhelmina-ruiterstandbeeld.json.
